scope: All available previous-season gameweek panels will be acquired and quality-profiled.
The 2026/27 seven-GW test uses pinned pre-deadline snapshots and no reconstructed news overrides.
Older-season features must be lagged and player IDs matched within season; cross-season codes are checked.
Contemporaneous odds/news unavailable in older archives will not be invented.
Data before 2022/23 may lack xG/starts; pre-2025/26 lacks current defensive scoring.
Fit on older data, select on a later validation season, then evaluate held-out later seasons/current weeks.
The model was designed after the first seven 2026/27 results were observed: retrospective predictions are not pristine prospective evidence.
No claim of historical Claude decisions or full transfer-policy returns will be made from absent decision records.

component_design.old_seasons: Lagged FPL points/minutes benchmarks, 2016/17-2022/23 development; no invented xG or starts.
component_design.full_points_validation: 2023/24: first validation year with archived xG/starts priors from a previous season.
component_design.candidate_pool: Single-fixture targets after first observation; prior three fixture mean minutes >=45, or GW<=3 and previous-season minutes>=900. Identical pool across variants.
component_design.statistical_grid: 17 variants: baseline plus window{3,6,10}/minutes-prior{0.5,2,6}, or rate half-life{4,8,16}/prior-minutes{450,900,1800}; one group varies at a time.
component_design.selection: Lowest validation RMSE, frozen before opening holdout scores.
component_design.promotion: At least 0.5% RMSE improvement in each of 2024/25 and 2025/26. No replacement winner chosen after holdout.
component_design.cutoff: Earliest gameweek kickoff minus 90min; features need kickoff+3h earlier, and lower GW.
component_design.schedules: Realised fixture assignments; older results are component tests without odds/news/schedule vintages.
